collegeFullAddress: Plot No. U-15, J.V.P.D. Scheme, Bhaktivedanta Swami Marg, Vile Parle (West), Mumbai, Maharashtra 400056
collegeInfo: Established in 1994, Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering (DJSCE) is a premier private engineering college in Mumbai, consistently ranked among the top engineering institutes in India. The college offers state-of-the-art infrastructure, vibrant student life, and outstanding placement opportunities with top national and international companies.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Top rankers in the qualifying exam (MHT-CET/JEE Main).
scholarships.applicationProcess: Automatically considered on admission based on results.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) as per Maharashtra Government norms.

events.eventFullDescription: Trinity is the flagship technical and cultural festival of DJ Sanghvi College, hosting coding challenges, robotics, workshops, cultural nights, literary arts, fashion, and sports events. It attracts participants from colleges across Mumbai and Maharashtra.

Innovatia is DJ Sanghvi’s principal technical symposium, featuring paper presentations, project displays, hackathons, and expert talks. The event fosters tech innovation, interdisciplinary learning, and industry interaction.

collegeName: D. J. Sanghvi College of Engineering

infrastructure.infraDescription: DJSCE’s campus offers modern smart classrooms, advanced labs, central library, Wi-Fi access, innovation incubation, auditoriums, sports courts, medical facilities, and hostels. Regular hackathons, inter-college events, and guest lectures enrich the student experience.
